g.text: Two ways to attach a host CPU: PCIe (x86 DGX H100) vs coherent NVLink-C2C (GB200 superchip)
A · x86 host over PCIe (DGX H100, per 4 GPUs)

text.tspan: GPU sees host memory as a separate pool:
copies via DMA at <=128 GB/s per x16 link;
no shared page tables, no cache coherence
(~450 GB/s per GPU when both GPUs pull)
One address space: a GPU kernel can load and store
Grace memory directly, so LPDDR5X becomes a
slower, larger second memory tier (KV cache, embeddings)
